components.name: Company knowledge
components.what: Roles, steps, cases, files, rules and skills — learned from approved records, never typed in.

components.name: Team simulator
components.what: Replays this team's recorded pre-auths under a different plan. Step times, hand-off waits, send-backs and arrivals fitted to the records; no hidden world.

components.name: Demand model
components.what: Not available for this industry: the US Census backtest covers NAICS 713940, 621111 and 722515.

d1.note: n/a for a fitted board: the real-data check of the simulator method is produced by `build` (see data/out/model.json).

limits.title: Other people's queues
limits.why: Hand-off waits are replayed as measured; freeing one person's hours does not shorten another's queue in this simulator.

limits.title: What an agent changes
limits.why: Agent does a step in 1 min, the person reviews in 3, 5% undone; send-backs unchanged. A template only removes layout send-backs people recorded.

limits.title: Hidden-truth checks
limits.why: Planted bottleneck rank and planted-synonym precision/recall need a synthetic world; here the checks are replay-vs-measured, plan stability and miner stability.

limits.title: Where to open next
limits.why: No backtested demand model for this industry yet.

plan_stability.best_plan: Auto-approve under $500 + agent does 'Eligibility check' (Front desk reviews)
